findings.title: unsubscribe crashes when no TopicUser record exists
findings.body: `TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, topic_id: params[:topic_id])` returns nil for a user who has no topic_users row (e.g. notified via category watching, or a PM invite where the row was never created). The very next line calls `tu.notification_level`, raising NoMethodError (500) for a plain link click from an email. Use `TopicUser.change(...)`/`find_or_initialize` and handle the nil case.

findings.title: Unsubscribe writes notification level directly, bypassing TopicUser.change
findings.body: The action mutates `tu.notification_level` and saves the record directly instead of going through `TopicUser.change`, so `notifications_changed_at`/`notifications_reason_id` are not updated and no MessageBus `notification_level_change` is published. Any open browser tab or other client keeps showing the stale notification level. Also note the toggle semantics: a user already at `regular` gets muted, so a second click on the same email link silently mutes the topic — repeated/prefetched requests are not idempotent.

findings.title: State-changing operation performed on a GET request
findings.body: `unsubscribe` changes the user's notification level on a GET (route `get "t/:slug/:topic_id/unsubscribe"`). Mail clients, link scanners and browser prefetchers routinely fetch links in emails, which will silently mute topics without the user's intent. The mutation should happen on a POST/PUT (e.g. the landing page confirms, then posts), or be guarded by a one-time key.

findings.title: unsubscribe_link now requires %{unsubscribe_url} for every caller
findings.body: The `unsubscribe_link` translation now interpolates `%{unsubscribe_url}`, but only `UserNotifications#send_notification_email` was updated to pass it. Any other `build_email` call with `add_unsubscribe_link: true` (and all plugins/mailers doing so) will raise `I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument` in `MessageBuilder#body`/`#html_part`, breaking those emails. Either make the second sentence conditional or default `unsubscribe_url` in `template_args`.

findings.title: topicUnsubscribe route is shadowed by topic.fromParamsNear
findings.body: The `topic` resource (declared earlier, path `/t/:slug/:id`) contains `fromParamsNear` with path `/:nearPost`, which matches `/t/slug/123/unsubscribe` with nearPost="unsubscribe" before the later `topicUnsubscribe` route is considered. In-app transitions / client-side handling of the unsubscribe URL will therefore land on the topic route with a bogus post number instead of the unsubscribe page.

findings.title: unsubscribe does not guard topic visibility explicitly and ignores JSON slug check
findings.body: `TopicView.new(params[:topic_id], current_user)` is relied on for access control, but unlike `show` there is no `rescue Discourse::NotFound` / redirect-by-slug handling, so a stale or wrong-slug link produces a raw 404/500 instead of a redirect. Additionally, no spec covers this new endpoint (nil TopicUser, muted/watching transitions, slug mismatch redirect), so the above bugs are untested.
